title: ApiReturnedLeaderboard guard drops legitimate responses on the two cold-load fetch paths that never set leaderboard_vacancy_id (session restore and demo entry)
detail: On a non-demo cold load/bookmark of /vacancies/A, ApiReturnedSession dispatches the leaderboard fetch with tag None, so the Ok response is dropped and the board sits at NotAsked until the poller's LeaderboardRefresh (~60s) fills it. On a demo deep-link boot, enter_demo/demo_entry_effects fetch with tag None and demo has no poller — the leaderboard never loads.
recommended_fix: Set `leaderboard: Loading, leaderboard_vacancy_id: Some(id)` in the ApiReturnedSession VacancyDetail/VacancyHandoff updated_model and in enter_demo's request_ids block for VacancyDetail routes, alongside vacancy_detail_request_id. Add a cold-boot test per path.

title: vacancy_detail pb-28 compare-bar padding still untested (still present since round 2)
detail: application_detail's pb-28 gained a revert-pin this round but vacancy_detail's identical conditional padding still has none; deleting `pb-28` there passes the suite. Same coverage gap flagged in rounds 1 and 2.
recommended_fix: Add a vacancy_detail view test asserting pb-28 present when comparison_ids non-empty and absent when empty, mirroring application_detail_reserves_room_when_comparing_test.

title: Filter pill shrink-0 change still has no test (still present since round 2)
detail: The fix-3 filter-pill shrink-0 remains unpinned; a revert in view_filter_pill passes the suite. Flagged in rounds 1 and 2 and still unaddressed.
recommended_fix: Add a leaderboard_view test rendering filter pills asserting the shrink-0 class on the pill buttons.

title: ApiReturnedLeaderboard Error branch ignores the vacancy tag — a late error from vacancy A overwrites B's in-flight board with Failure copy
detail: The Ok arm is guarded by `current == vacancy_id`, but the Error arm matches `_` on the tag. Sequence: A fetch in flight, navigate to B (board Loading, tag B), A's request fails → B's Loading flips to a spurious 'couldn't load' Failure until B's Ok lands. Same in ApiReturnedLeaderboardPage: `Error(_), _, _` clears B's leaderboard_loading_more on A's stale error.
recommended_fix: Guard both Error arms on the tag match too: `Error(err), Some(current) if current == vacancy_id`, falling through to the no-op `_, _` arm otherwise.
